newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds outperform dlr bloc again.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds outperform dlr bloc again.

text.p: Australian bonds made a sharp outperformance against the dollar bloc with the long-end finally showing signs that it wanted to break its ties with concerns in the U.S., traders said.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread broke through 100 basis points to stand at its lowest level since mid-December.

The U.S. faces the December PPI report later today and non-farm payrolls on Friday, although local traders believe that the U.S. long-end has already done sufficient on the downside in anticipation of the worst case scenairo in both cases.
The market is also building in the possibility of a further easing in official interest rates following the February 4 Reserve Bank board meeting and in anticipation that inflation will remain weak.
The Australian CPI report is due on January 29.
